about: Places where Scripture itself explains a name. Each entry is anchored to KJV word positions ("GEN.029.033:011": book, chapter, verse, word), which never change; the Keyway Token Vault IDs under "vault" are derived from them through the KJV word alignment and rebuilt as it improves. See docs/how-it-works.md.
